text: Haseeb Manzoor is an AI Engineer with expertise in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Generative AI. He has hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and MLOps pipelines.
Haseeb Manzoor was born in Okara, Punjab, Pakistan. He currently lives in Rawalpindi, Punjab, Pakistan. His hometown is Tehsil Nakyal, District Kotli, Azad Kashmir, Pakistan.

Haseeb Manzoor completed his Matriculation and FSc (Pre-Engineering) from Army Public School and College System, Okara Cantt. He earned a BS in Electrical Engineering from COMSATS University Islamabad (2020–2025) and is currently pursuing an MS in Artificial Intelligence at NUST Islamabad (2025–present).

Haseeb Manzoor chose Artificial Intelligence after Electrical Engineering due to his strong interest in programming and computing. During his BS, he studied courses such as Introduction to Programming, Object-Oriented Programming, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning.
Haseeb Manzoor completed his Bachelor's Final Year Project in the domain of Internet of Things (IoT).
Haseeb Manzoor can be contacted via phone or WhatsApp at +92 319 1140506 or by email at iamhaseebmanzoor@gmail.com.

Haseeb Manzoor is skilled in Python and Java. His expertise includes TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Hugging Face, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, FastAPI, Streamlit, Docker, MLflow, GitHub Actions, AWS, RAG, fine-tuning, LoRA, QLoRA, Whisper, and vector databases such as ChromaDB, Weaviate, Pinecone, and PostgreSQL.

Haseeb Manzoor designed and trained an Encoder–Decoder Transformer for English to Urdu translation using PyTorch. The model included multi-head attention, cross-attention, RMSNorm, SwiGLU, and SentencePiece tokenization, achieving a BLEU score of 22.96.

Haseeb Manzoor built an AI Trip Organizer Agent using LangChain, LangGraph, Streamlit, and FastAPI with multi-step workflows, real-time interaction, and API integrations for weather, currency, and expenses.
Haseeb Manzoor developed a RAG-based agentic application with hybrid retrieval, domain-specific vector stores, multimodal input, contextual compression, and Docker-based deployment.

Haseeb Manzoor worked as an AI/ML Engineer at DevelopersHub Corporation (remote) from March 2025 to May 2025, where he developed sentiment analysis, fake news detection, credit risk modeling, anomaly detection, and BERT-based emotion recognition systems.
